question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
WITH model_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(toy_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(toy_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) as order_date,
            CAST(DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) - CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + 1 as day_num,
            SUM(oi.price) as toy_sales
        FROM orders o
        JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        JOIN products pr ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id
        WHERE pr.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
          AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01' 
          AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
        GROUP BY DATE(order_purchase_timestamp)
    )
),
all_predictions AS (
    SELECT '2018-12-03' as date_str, 702 as day_num, slope * 702 + intercept as predicted_sales FROM model_params
    UNION ALL SELECT '2018-12-04', 703, slope * 703 + intercept FROM model_params
    UNION ALL SELECT '2018-12-05', 704, slope * 704 + intercept FROM model_params
    UNION ALL SELECT '2018-12-06', 705, slope * 705 + intercept FROM model_params
    UNION ALL SELECT '2018-12-07', 706, slope * 706 + intercept FROM model_params
    UNION ALL SELECT '2018-12-08', 707, slope * 707 + intercept FROM model_params
    UNION ALL SELECT '2018-12-09', 708, slope * 708 + intercept FROM model_params
    UNION ALL SELECT '2018-12-10', 709, slope * 709 + intercept FROM model_params
),
ma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        '2018-12-05' as ma_date,
        (SELECT AVG(predicted_sales) FROM all_predictions WHERE date_str IN ('2018-12-03', '2018-12-04', '2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07')) as ma_value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-06',
        (SELECT AVG(predicted_sales) FROM all_predictions WHERE date_str IN ('2018-12-04', '2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08')) as ma_value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-07',
        (SELECT AVG(predicted_sales) FROM all_predictions WHERE date_str IN ('2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08', '2018-12-09')) as ma_value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-08',
        (SELECT AVG(predicted_sales) FROM all_predictions WHERE date_str IN ('2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08', '2018-12-09', '2018-12-10')) as ma_value
)
SELECT SUM(ma_value) as total_sum
FROM ma_calc
